description: Discover the best hotels in Crete, Greece. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.vendor_name: Castello Infinity Suites Crete - Adults Only
hotels.title: Crete Adults-Only Beachfront Haven with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & One-Time Floating Breakfast
hotels.description: Wake up to the gentle sound of waves at Castello Infinity Suites, an adults-only retreat perched on the shores of Agia Pelagia Bay in Crete. Each of the 28 suites and maisonettes offers a private terrace with a heated plunge pool, inviting you to unwind while gazing at the endless blue. Start and end the day at Galea restaurant, serving up a fusion of Mediterranean and international cuisine, with dishes crafted from seasonal Cretan ingredients. Unwind in style with a treatment or hydrotherapy session at the decadent Callista Spa, or work up a sweat at the fitness centre. Beyond the hotel, the vibrant village of Agia Pelagia is just steps away, offering crystal-clear waters and local tavernas to explore.

hotels.title: Crete Five-Star Art-Inspired Oasis Overlooking Mirabello Bay with Two Private Beaches
hotels.description: Greek island opulence awaits at Minos Beach Art Hotel, a chic five-star Crete oasis overlooking the glistening waterfront of Mirabello Bay. Adorned with a wealth of contemporary art and a façade of fuchsia blooms, this architectural retreat (part of the prestigious Design Hotels collections) balances minimalist design with maximum luxury. This is an ultra-modern oasis softening 2.5 kilometres of rugged Cretan coastline through its elegant assembly of waterfront accommodation and picturesque gardens. When you're not plunging into the sun-kissed ocean or sipping cocktails at the beachfront bar, choose to bask in the Greek heat on one of two private beaches or escape the rays with a stroll around the hotel's open-air art museum. Nourish your soul with authentic food and wine across three exceptional restaurants and indulge in a daily Kafeneion pick-me-up at the traditional coffee shop before curating your day in paradise. The onsite dive centre offers an array of activities for the adventurous, from windsurfing to waterskiing, while the wellness spa promises absolute bliss for those seeking relaxation.

hotels.title: Eastern Crete Coastal Retreat near Mirabello Bay with Tranquil Infinity Pools
hotels.description: Experience the epitome of Crete luxury with a stay at this beachfront oasis overlooking Mirabello Bay. Explore the charming coastal town of Agios Nikolaos, or venture further afield to Archanes, renowned for its vineyards and olive groves. Return to your tranquil base and take a dip in two glittering infinity pools which appear to merge harmoniously with the bay beyond, or simply savour a refreshing beverage at the hotel's onsite bars.

hotels.title: Five-Star Greek Island Getaway with Aegean Sea Views & Onsite Par-3 Golf Course
hotels.description: Draped along Crete's Mirabello Bay, this luxury resort brings the sparkling Aegean Sea into focus, as golf, dining and a dreamy spa complete an idyllic Greek retreat. Guests could be forgiven for never leaving this coastal sanctuary, complete with two restaurants, two bars and a private, 9-hole par-3 golf course. The Six Senses Spa brings world-class wellness to the Cretan coastline, with a 2,200sqm sanctuary blending Eastern and Western techniques across 23 treatment rooms, a Turkish hammam and a thalassotherapy pool. On the water, watersports, scuba diving and sailing keep things active. Once you've built up an appetite on the golf course or strolling the quiet streets of Elounda, resort dining spans everything from Greek buffets at Cosmos to fresh and healthy share plates at Elies Beach House by bestselling author, Emily English. For a laidback drink, head to Thea where expert bartenders will satisfy with every sip serving tropical and tasty tipples.
